CustomField.description: This field is to check destination of the incoterm which is dependent on Incoterm1 and Region
CustomField.formula: IF( PMC_CPQ_QuoteRegionExtractor__c = 'North America', IF(OR( ISPICKVAL( PMC_CPQ_Incoterms1__c , 'FOB'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_CPQ_Incoterms1__c , 'FCA')),'Origin','Destination'), IF(PMC_CPQ_QuoteRegionExtractor__c = 'Brazil','Origin','Destination'))
CustomField.label: Back End Incoterms2
